'''CH-1's creator''' was an individual who wished to create the perfect [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] made [[CH-1]] and granted the droid a unique self-improvement programming, seeking to continually modify and upgrade itself.<ref name="UABS" />
